newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom opts for Concert - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom opts for Concert - paper.

text.p: Portugal Telecom has opted for the proposed British Telecom -MCI Communications Corp alliance Concert as its strategic partner, the Capital newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Asked to comment on the report, a spokesman for the state-controlled company said merely that talks were continuing with potential partners.
"In accordance with the timetable established, the negotiations (with possible partners) continue," the spokesman told Reuters.

Capital cited "sources close to the negotiations" as saying that Portugal Telcom had opted for Concert over the other two candidates -- Global One, which links Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint, and the Unisource/Uniworld venture of AT&T, Spain's Telefonica, the Dutch PTT-KPN and others.
"The choice of Concert came after a thorough study carried out by Morgan Grenfell that pointed to that consortium as being the best-placed globally," Capital said.
Morgan Grenfell and Arthur D. Little are offical consulants to Portugal Telecom in its search for a strategic ally who would take a small stake in the telecommunications group.
The government plans to float a further tranche of Portugal Telecom this year which would take its holding below 50 percent. It currently stands at 51 percent.
The telecommunications company said at the end of last year that it hoped to be able to announce its choice of strategic partner by March.
